hunt.name: Delivery and Payload Execution Monitoring
hunt.description: Adversaries frequently bypass perimeter defenses by exploiting trusted software distribution channels or using social engineering to deliver payloads directly to the endpoint. This hunt monitors for these footholds by identifying unusual software installation events (supply chain leads) and corroborating them with browser-originating file activity and rare process launches in user-writable paths. An agent then evaluates the combined evidence per host to distinguish legitimate software deployment from malicious intrusion.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_full_name, package_source_uri, signer_subject_name, deployment_flags, time FROM hb_application_lifecycle WHERE (signer_subject_name IS NULL OR signer_subject_name = '' OR deployment_flags = 8388608 OR LOWER(package_source_uri) LIKE 'http:%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify potential supply chain compromises by finding package installations that lack valid signatures or originate from unusual source URIs.
config.expected_signal: A row indicates an unsigned or potentially external package was installed. Silence proves no such installations were logged by the AppX or MSI providers.

primitive_config.label: Unusual or unsigned software installations
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_full_name, package_source_uri, signer_subject_name, deployment_flags, time FROM hb_application_lifecycle WHERE (signer_subject_name IS NULL OR signer_subject_name = '' OR deployment_flags = 8388608 OR LOWER(package_source_uri) LIKE 'http:%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: A row indicates an unsigned or potentially external package was installed. Silence proves no such installations were logged by the AppX or MSI providers.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_path, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\downloads\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\temp\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\users\\public\\%') AND LOWER(process_path) IN (SELECT LOWER(process_path) FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\downloads\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\temp\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\users\\public\\%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) <= 3) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find executables running from Downloads, Temp, or Public folders that are rare across the fleet, suggesting a user-initiated payload.
config.expected_signal: A binary seen on only one or two hosts in a user-writable path. High host counts likely indicate legitimate temporary software like installers or updaters.

primitive_config.label: Rare processes from user-writable paths
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_path, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\downloads\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\temp\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\users\\public\\%') AND LOWER(process_path) IN (SELECT LOWER(process_path) FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\downloads\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\temp\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\users\\public\\%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) <= 3) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: A binary seen on only one or two hosts in a user-writable path. High host counts likely indicate legitimate temporary software like installers or updaters.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, file_path, file_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{browser_processes}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 AND (LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.exe' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.msi' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.zip' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.iso' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.vbs' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.js' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.msix' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.appx' OR (instr(file_name, '.') > 0 AND instr(',' || '{{phishing_extensions}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(SUBSTR(file_name, INSTR(file_name, '.'))) || ',') > 0)) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Corroborate phishing lures by identifying browser or mail processes writing files with executable or container extensions.
config.expected_signal: Rows mapping a browser or mail client to a newly written payload file. Silence does not prove absence if the adversary used a non-standard download method.

config.objective: Determine if any host shows evidence of a malicious initial access foothold. Correlate findings per-host and bridge the gap between unusual installers (suggesting supply chain compromise) and subsequent rare process activity or suspicious browser-originating downloads.
config.description: Analyse the installation events, rare process launches, and browser downloads to determine if a host has been compromised.
config.expected_signal: A per-host verdict of malicious, suspicious, or benign.
config.success_criteria: A final verdict for every host that appeared in more than one query result, citing the specific rows that connect the delivery to execution.

config.question: the triage-verdict verdict is malicious for at least one host
config.condition: the triage-verdict verdict is malicious for at least one host

config.instructions: Review the rows cited by the triage agent. Check for any legitimate business context for the unsigned installation or the rare process launch. If the host was isolated, verify the artifact is indeed malicious.
